extracted.intended_audience: used car shoppers / consumers looking for a 2019 Toyota Camry near San Francisco, CA
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating and comparing used 2019 Toyota Camry listings (model-level review + individual listing attributes) for purchase decisions in a local market.

rubrics_metrics.name: CarGurus model overall score
rubrics_metrics.description: CarGurus Analysis: 2019 Toyota Camry — 7.8 of 10 overall (also shows a model-level summary earlier: '4.8' under a different heading).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a single numeric summary of the model's strengths and weaknesses in the market; used to compare models. No explicit scoring rubric shown on-page beyond the numeric value and comparative commentary.

rubrics_metrics.name: CarGurus sub-scores (Look and feel, Technology, Performance, Safety, Form & function, Cost effectiveness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of the overall CarGurus score into component ratings: Look and feel 6/10, Technology 8/10, Performance 8/10, Safety 10/10, Form & function 6/10, Cost effectiveness 9/10.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These component scores indicate which aspects drive the overall rating — e.g., Safety = 10/10, Form & function lower — useful when buyers prioritize certain dimensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner rating
rubrics_metrics.description: Owners rated the 2019 Toyota Camry 4.8 / 5 stars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate owner satisfaction metric drawn from user reviews; complements expert CarGurus scores by reflecting real-world ownership experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Good/Great deal percentage
rubrics_metrics.description: With 200 currently listed for sale near San Francisco, CA and an average price of $20,106.00, 33.0% of 2019 Toyota Camrys for sale on CarGurus are rated as good or great deals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows the proportion of listings considered good/great deals in the current market; helps buyers gauge pricing competitiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accident/ damage history (% accident free)
rubrics_metrics.description: 100.0% of 2019 Camry models on CarGurus are accident free.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the prevalence of clean vehicle history reports among listed vehicles; buyers should verify vehicle history reports despite aggregate claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manufacturer / third‑party certification status
rubrics_metrics.description: Individual listings can be labeled 'Manufacturer certified' or 'Third-party certified'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certified listings often imply inspections, warranties, or added assurances; the page displays these labels on listings and they factor into perceived deal quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deal classification label
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings are tagged with deal labels such as 'Great Deal', 'Good Deal', or 'Fair Deal'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These qualitative labels summarize how listing price compares to market expectations; useful for quick filtering but buyers should inspect specifics (mileage, condition).

rubrics_metrics.name: Price and price trends
rubrics_metrics.description: Average price figures and trends: e.g., average price of 2019 Toyota Camry near SF = about $18,750.74; page shows 'AVG Price' ($18,751), 'Index Price' ($28,857) and price ranges ($8,825 to $35,958).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes historical trends and comparisons to other model years; helps buyers understand fair market value and seasonal/long-term shifts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mileage (listing odometer)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listing shows mileage (e.g., 57,865 mi, 104,344 mi, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key factor affecting price and vehicle condition; lower mileage generally preferred. Page also surfaces 'Used with low mileage' filters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vehicle attributes (year, make, model, trim, engine, drivetrain, transmission, colors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings enumerate year, make, model, trim (SE, LE, XSE, XLE, TRD, etc.), engine (2.5L I4, 3.5L V6, horsepower where shown), drivetrain (FWD), transmission (8-Speed Automatic), exterior & interior color.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Essential specs that determine desirability, fuel economy, performance, and price differences among listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fuel economy / fuel type
rubrics_metrics.description: Combined gas mileage figures shown per listing (e.g., 33 MPG, 32 MPG, 27 MPG) and page-level statement: 'Depending on the engine and options, the 2019 Toyota Camry gets between 26 and 34 MPG.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Important for running cost comparisons; varies by engine/trim. Buyers should match expected MPG to driving needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safety ratings and awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Model-level safety credentials: 'received a 5-star safety rating from NHTSA' and 'Top Safety Pick+ from the IIHS'; CarGurus Safety sub-score = 10/10.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level safety endorsements that impact family-buying decisions; buyers should verify safety features and crash-test results for specific trims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model pros and cons (Why it stands out)
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative evaluation highlights: exceptional safety ratings, sporty design in XSE V6, impressive fuel efficiency; critiques include interior material quality and trunk space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Qualitative summary of strengths and weaknesses drawn from market data and expert review; useful for buyers balancing tradeoffs (performance vs. interior quality).

rubrics_metrics.name: Listing completeness / photos availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing-level indicators such as 'Preparing for a close up... Photos coming soon' appear when photos are missing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete photo sets are expected for thorough inspection; missing photos are an anti-pattern and should prompt caution or request for more images.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location / distance and delivery options
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listing shows seller location and distance (e.g., Santa Rosa, 47 mi away) and labels like 'Home delivery from Reno, NV' or 'Price includes $374 shipping'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distance impacts convenience and potential travel/shipping costs; home delivery and shipping-fee disclosures affect total out-the-door cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Included fees / dealer fees disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings show phrases like 'Fees may apply' or 'Includes dealer fees'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transparency about dealer fees affects the buyer's assessment of total cost; 'Includes dealer fees' indicates the displayed price may already include some fees, while 'Fees may apply' warns of additional charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Price change / price-drop indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings can show 'Price drop' with the amount (e.g., '-$404').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals market movement or seller motivation; useful to time offers but buyers should verify reason for price change (time on market, condition).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trim and engine performance indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings highlight performance specs where relevant (e.g., '206 hp 2.5L I4', '3.5L V6', '301-horsepower V6 option' mentioned in model review).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performance numbers help buyers choose between fuel efficiency and power; mentioned in model narrative as differentiators (sporty XSE V6).

rubrics_metrics.name: Model-year comparisons / other years to consider
rubrics_metrics.description: Page lists other model years to consider with avg price and good/great deal percentage (e.g., 2023, 2024, 2025 Camry stats).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps shoppers evaluate tradeoffs of buying newer/older model years (price vs. features); use to broaden search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial research provenance
rubrics_metrics.description: Analysis is 'based on CarGurus' proprietary market data from May 5, 2026, CarGurus experts' opinions, and generative AI.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains the data sources and methodology behind model-level claims; readers should consider the mix of data, expert opinion, and AI when weighing reliability.
